### An Adventure Through Starstruck Nostalgia!
## About In our minecraft server, we try to turn Modern Minecraft into a nostalgic throwback to the old console edition! Like there used to be on the Xbox 360, Playstation, Nintendo Switch, the Wii U and more!
## Features Over time the SMP will expand to further push the recreation of those old versions! Play with many features such as: - Old Textures! - Old Combat! - Old World Terrain! - Bedrock Support!
